Team — consolidated first pass attached (Redwood_Consolidated_DPA_Redline_v2.pdf). Below are the principal open items I think we should resolve before handing to Counsel for final language: 

1) Subprocessor clause: FutureBank wants 15 days' notice + objection right. Our standard is 30 days' notice + opportunity to object, with automatic mitigation (use alternative vendor) only for narrow categories. Recommend: accept 30-day notice but propose a 10-business-day objection window tied to specific material risks; if unresolved escalate to CISO/legal.

2) Transfer mechanism: FB insists on SCCs + Addendum. We already plan to offer SCCs + EU-US Addendum (company addendum) for US-hosted workloads. Confirm whether we need an operational clause to pin where logs with customer PII are stored.

3) Audit rights: FB's redline requests unlimited on-site audit for material incidents. Counsel will want to limit to "reasonable scope and notice" and prefer remote evidence collection first.

4) Retention & deletion: FB requests 7-year retention for regulatory artifacts. We typically commit to customer-requested retention periods but not blanket 7-year retention for all logging. Recommend: propose Annex B for retention schedule per product and customer classification.

5) Liability/indemnity: FB requested carve-outs for security incidents tied to subprocessor failure. Need counsel input on caps and whether we accept narrow carve-outs.

eSign: From an ops perspective DocuSign is fine if FutureBank can sign both DPA and Annex as a single envelope. If they prefer AdobeSign, confirm signer workflow.

Next steps: Steph, can you draft counsel positions for 1–4 and mark anything that needs executive approval? I'll prep the consolidated PDF and send it to Kate with a proposed eSign envelope link.

Attachments: Redwood_Consolidated_DPA_Redline_v2.pdf

Ben
Senior Sales Ops — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Consolidated DPA redlines & eSign plan — FutureBank (FB-2026-048)

Team & Kate — my counsel notes (high level) below. I attached a short memo (SOC2 summary included) to the Drive link in case FB counsel wants evidence pre-counter.

1) Subprocessors — proposed Redwood position:
- We accept notification but request 30 days' notice for new subprocessors to ensure operational transition and security checks.
- Objection window: 10 business days after notice. If FutureBank objects on reasonable grounds (security/regulatory), escalate to Redwood CISO + FB security contact for remediation. If unresolved, parties will use a 30-day mitigation period.

2) Transfers & SCCs — proposed Redwood position:
- SCCs are fine as the baseline. For EU-US transfers, Redwood will execute the standard SCCs and append our company-specific addendum (we will provide the addendum text).
- We will include a paragraph describing location of logs and processed data for clarity (operational addendum), but we will not agree to a prohibition on lawful cross-border routing that would break routing/failover.

3) Audit & evidence:
- Decline unlimited on-site audits. Accept remote evidence review first (logs, test results, SOC 2 summary). For material incidents, allow an independent auditor with reasonable scope & notice; Redwood will require pre-agreed scoping and confidentiality terms.

4) Retention:
- We cannot commit to a blanket 7-year retention for all operational logs. Offer Annex B (customer-specific retention schedule) and commit to retention for regulated data types as requested by customer with appropriate pricing if out of standard scope.

5) Liability & indemnity:
- Counsel recommends limited carve-outs for data breaches caused by Redwood's negligence. Will not agree to unlimited liability for subprocessor failures absent gross negligence.

Execution path:
- Recommend we send the consolidated redline + counsel positions back to FB and request a single DocuSign envelope covering the DPA + Annex B. If FB's legal insists on AdobeSign, ops can accommodate but we prefer DocuSign for our standard template and audit trail.

Evidence & attachments provided to FB on request: SOC2_TypeII_summary_2026.pdf; PenTest_summary_2026.pdf (summary). We will provide full reports under NDA or after countersign.

Happy to hop on quick call with FB legal — suggest 30 minutes Thu or Fri this week to finalize high-risk language.

Steph
Privacy Counsel — Redwood Inference
